scope: 25 dedicated hero awakenings; existing m12 bronze gate and f13 omen pages retained, 23 dedicated generated illustrations added
basePrompt: Create ONE production 2D game VFX sprite with REAL transparent alpha background, portrait 1024x1536 composition. Use the supplied hero artwork as a DIRECT STYLE reference: match its crisp polished wuxia anime linework, intricate finely shaded materials, dimensional painterly rendering, saturated but elegant fantasy color, soft luminous edges. No character, human, portrait, face, background scene, panel, rectangular border, text, letters, watermark, UI or geometric wireframe illustration. It is an isolated surrounding EFFECT to overlay a 2:3 hero portrait. The central 68% of width across the middle 80% of height must be EMPTY TRANSPARENT so the face and torso remain unobstructed. Put richly rendered physical motifs only in narrow OUTER SIDE regions or extreme top/bottom corners. Do not fill the center with a glow plate. Keep every object, glow and wisp fully inside the canvas with 6% transparent edge padding, no cropping. The reference is style and material guidance; do not reproduce the hero itself.
